value.rationale: The main object is the directly motivated complementary class in a recent paper, and its asymptotic density was left unexplored. Unlike routine 9^k avoidance, the theorem identifies a positive explicit 8^k term split into exactly three prime-digit mechanisms and proves the remainder is exponentially smaller. This is a complete two-scale structural count of a natural statistic, with independently checkable finite coefficients.
